title: Heart motif — basic
subtitle: A flat applique heart in DK cotton, 8 cm wide
excerpt: The basic heart motif is worked in two symmetrical halves from a centre chain, with dc rows forming each lobe, then joined at the base with a V-point. At 8 cm wide in DK cotton the silhouette is clean and unmistakable. Used for Valentine's Day decorations, children's blanket appliques, and scatter motifs on throws.
sourceNotes: Weldon's Practical Crochet, Volume 3 (1888), heart motif chapter (Internet Archive). Therese de Dillmont, Encyclopedia of Needlework (1886), crochet heart and love token motifs.

chartDefinition.title: Heart motif — basic
chartDefinition.caption: Two half-circles for the upper lobes, each started from a ch-4 ring. Both halves joined along the bottom with dc decrease rows to form the V-point at the base.

glossaryTerms.definition: One of the two rounded upper bumps of a heart shape. Each lobe is a small half-circle worked from a chain ring and joined to the other at the base.

content.text: The basic heart works two independent small half-circles — one for each upper
lobe

— then joins them along the bottom and works decrease rows down to a single V-point. Each lobe is a ch-4 slip-stitch ring with 10 dc worked around the outside of the ring in a semicircle. The flat base of each semicircle is the joining line.

attrs.title: Materials for one motif
attrs.body: About 8 g of DK cotton in red, pink, or any colour. A 4 mm hook. Tapestry needle. Scissors.

content.text: Gauge
Each finished basic heart motif measures 8 cm wide and 7 cm tall in DK-weight cotton with a 4 mm hook.
Stitches used
chain (ch), slip stitch (sl st) — UK and US shared.
double crochet (dc), dc2tog — UK; US "single crochet / sc2tog".
Pattern
Left lobe

Ch 4. Sl st into first ch to form a ring. Ch 1. Work 10dc around the ring, positioning all 10 dc on the upper half (leave the lower half of the ring open for the joining row). Do not join with sl st. Fasten off with a 15 cm tail.
Right lobe
Make a second identical lobe. Do not fasten off — this is the working yarn for the joining row.
Join and taper

Position both lobes with their flat base edges adjacent. Ch 1. Dc across all stitches of the right lobe (10 dc), then dc across all stitches of the left lobe (10 dc). (20 dc.) Turn. Row 2: Ch 1. *Dc. Dc2tog.* Repeat across. Turn. (About 16 dc.) Row 3: Ch 1. Dc2tog across entire row. Turn. (About 8 dc.) Row 4: Work to the centre 2 stitches. Dc2tog at centre. Continue to end. (About 6 dc.) Row 5 (V-point): Dc2tog. Dc2tog. Sl st to join. Fasten off.

definition.title: Heart motif — basic
definition.caption: Two ch-4 ring semicircles (10dc each). Joined at base for 20dc. Four decrease rows to V-point.

content.text: Finishing
Weave in all ends. Sew the heart onto the base fabric or use as a standalone ornament by attaching a hanging thread at the V-point tip.
Care
Handwash in cool water. Lay flat to dry.
What to try next
